Travel and Expense Policy

Employees travelling on company business can claim reasonable costs. Claims must be submitted in the expense tool within 60 days of the trip, with itemised receipts attached.

Economy class is required for flights shorter than six hours. Business class may be booked for longer flights with prior approval from a director.

Hotel costs are reimbursed up to 180 euros per night in major cities and 120 euros per night elsewhere. The daily meal allowance is 45 euros and covers breakfast, lunch and dinner.

Mileage for private cars used on company business is reimbursed at 0.30 euros per kilometre. Taxis are allowed when public transport is unavailable or after 10 pm.

Alcohol, minibar charges, fines and personal entertainment are never reimbursed. Lost receipts can be replaced by a signed declaration only twice per calendar year.

Corporate cards must not be used for personal purchases. Misuse may lead to the card being withdrawn.
